name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop
description: macOS desktop app over the dsh Web UI: an Electron shell that supervises a local `dsh web` server and restyles it as a desktop workbench
author: zharness

scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac:dir: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run build && node scripts/stage-runtime.mjs && node scripts/fetch-node.mjs --arch x64 && electron-builder --mac --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
